preconditions.description: The input string contains only alphanumeric characters.

postconditions.description: The function returns the correct expansion for the given string.
The function correctly handles a string with a single numeric prefix followed by letters.
The function does not incorrectly repeat characters when a numeric prefix is followed by letters.
The function does not incorrectly repeat characters when a numeric prefix is followed by letters.
The function correctly handles a string with multiple numeric prefixes.
The function returns the input string unchanged if there are no numeric prefixes.
The function returns an empty string for an empty input.
